# Welcome to My Portfolio

Hi I'm Ben - a data scientist with a background in industrial statistics and food science. I have a few projects featured here, my blog contains more projects and thoughts, and soon I'll be posting on YouTube as well. Let me know if you'd like to collaborate or hear more about a topic!

Update 7/1/25 I have just started this portfolio recently, I will be adding more each day this week.

- Featured Project: [Real Time SPC](https://benjepson.github.io/realtime-SPC)
This one is really exciting. I'm using the power of Statistical Process Control (SPC) to track my fitness progress. Unlike a textbook example where you are given a dataset, this dataset is being generated in real time, day by day, week by week, and I don't know how it's going to go. We will find out together. Keep checking back for updates!
